question: What scale of ritual performance brings an entire kingdom completely under control?
premises: The ritual is performed one million times.
The target extends beyond the king to his kingdom.
The kingdom becomes controllable in all ways.
inference: Performing the ritual one million times brings that kingdom completely under the practitioner's control.
uncertainties: Whether 'daśa+lakṣeṇa' refers to recitations or oblations depends on prior context.
plain_english: By one million, that kingdom becomes completely controllable by him in all ways.
